user.title: Appliance Watch
user.description: Nothing meters the dishwasher, so it is read from whatever is left of the house's consumption once every metered appliance is subtracted. Point at the house total, then at what is already measured elsewhere.

data_description.measured_entities: A sensor that drops out suspends detection instead of counting 0 W: a missing reading would inflate the residual by exactly that much.
data_description.optional_entities: A car charger, for instance, which reports nothing while unplugged.
data_description.washer_status_entity: The machine's “Current status”. Its remaining time and programme length are read from the same device. While the washer is idle, whatever the laundry meter sees is the dryer.

init.title: Washer, solar start and detection thresholds
init.description: Measured on this installation: the dishwasher steps 1 940-2 015 W above the ambient base, the oven 2 150-2 230 W. The band must hold the first and exclude the second.

data_description.dryer_off_delay_minutes: Silence below the idle threshold before closing the cycle. Measured: mid-cycle silences up to 300 s, so under 6 min the activity risks being cut and restarted.
data_description.washer_status_entity: The machine's “Current status”. Its remaining time and programme length are read from the same device. While the washer is idle, whatever the laundry meter sees is the dryer.
data_description.grid_entity: Without it the washer never starts on its own. Armed for remote start, it starts when a cycle started now would cost at least the required saving less than the same cycle taken entirely from the grid.
data_description.solar_min_saving_pct: Accepted only when production is unsteady or the forecast peak is an hour behind. At 50 %, about 400 W of export held for half an hour.
data_description.solar_entity: Used to judge whether production is steady. Without it, production is deemed unsteady and the minimum saving is enough.
data_description.solar_good_saving_pct: Starts as soon as it is reached. 90 %: the heating is covered by the sun.
